entities.summary: Persian Empire, a political institution in Greece during Alexander the Great and the Hellenistic Period (336 BCE–323 BCE). Grew from Rise of Macedon and Philip II. Led to the emergence of Death of Alexander the Great in Babylon and Hellenistic Successor Kingdoms.
